'''Stal Rzeszów''', commonly referred to as '''Stal''', is a Polish [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Rzeszów]] in the southeastern [[Podkarpackie Voivodeship|Podkarpackie]] [[Voivodeships of Poland|voivodeship]], competing in the [[I liga]], the second tier of [[Polish football league system|Polish league football]], since their promotion in 2022. Formed in 1944 by aviation factory workers, the club has spent a majority of its history playing in the lower leagues of Polish football. Their highest league finish was in 1966 when they finished 7th in the [[Ekstraklasa]]. The club's greatest achievement is winning the [[Polish Cup]] in 1975. Stal also has 2 I liga titles and 5 [[II liga]] titles on its record. Stal Rzeszów is part of a [[Stal Rzeszów (multi-sports club)|multi-sports club]] featuring football, boxing, motorcycle speedway, and other departments. Stal Rzeszów plays their home games at the [[Stal Rzeszów Municipal Stadium]] ({{Langx|pl|Stadion Miejski "Stal" w Rzeszowie}})."}}
